description: EXPR-BIND, deciding variants: schema change under saved queries, with no Requery. Sc(ID, A) holds two rows; saved QStar (SELECT * FROM Sc) and QCols (SELECT ID, A FROM Sc) are opened and read; ALTER TABLE Sc ADD COLUMN X is run while a recordset of QStar is still open and again after closing it; QStar and QCols are opened and Fields read; ALTER TABLE Sc DROP COLUMN A is run and both are opened again; Sc is dropped and recreated with A as Text and both are opened again. Follow-up probe (status F) for EXPR-BIND; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
